scope: Pure physics and model simulations. The named empty-tray branch uses an explicit disposable fixture; public playback and promotional recordings use no state, save or timer injection.

checks.name: bounded typed recipes preserve actual order offsets and literal names
layout matches food collider dimensions and weighted center of mass
visible OBB contacts respect gaps widths and actual rotations
same recipe mass with different offsets changes real dynamic wobble
reordering identical ingredients changes actual support and motion
slippery tall recipe loses real layers while the starter remains intact
careful pace preserves actual wet layers but sacrifices distance
tray controls change real kinematic position and ingredient motion
lost ingredients continue a physical fall rather than freezing in air
a rotated ingredient touching the actual ground cannot still score as carried food
the shared visible route is deterministic and careful never selects an easier route
invalid physics time and input are rejected without mutation
phase gates keep assembly out of active delivery
empty workbench edits are allowed and deadline falls back safely
fixed stepping produces identical physical delivery at30and120fps
pause freezes physical motion clocks and events and releases input
a complete careful series uses178seconds and earns exactly one local record
actual arrival ends a leg early and the score uses only surviving food
empty-tray early ending waits1.75seconds and never fabricates replacement food
unfinished reload and cancel retain earned progress without minting points
corrupt local data and returned snapshots cannot alter the active burger
